name: presentationkit
description: Manifest-driven presentation generation toolkit for evidence-first technical stories.

scripts.plan:example: node src/cli.js plan examples/operational-ai-support.deck.json --out dist/plan --diagrams dist/diagrams --deck-out dist/operational-ai-support.pptx
scripts.build:example: node src/cli.js build examples/operational-ai-support.deck.json --out dist/operational-ai-support.pptx --plan-out dist/plan
scripts.smoke: npm run check && npm run plan:example && npm run render:example && npm run build:example
